runs.text: The Satani are part of the Telugu people cluster within the South Asian Peoples affinity bloc. This people group is only found in India.

Some still pursue their traditional vocations serving as temple priests, servants attached to temples or sacred specialists. They belong to the Vaishnava sect of Hinduism and follow the teachings of Ramanuja. Sacred specialists from their own community perform all the religious rites. The Satani worship Vishnu, Lakshmi and regional deities.There are no known followers of Jesus Christ yet among the Satani people group, although there may be believers who have not made themselves known to outsiders.

A Hindu who accepts and follows Christ is likely to experience much disfavor and even hostility. Loss of friendships and status in the community is likely, and very difficult to deal with. They need the spiritual strength that will allow them to embrace Christ no matter what the cost.
